**`crates/iwe/tests/find_test.rs`** — Added 9 new tests covering `--count` with no filters, empty workspace, query, `--roots`, `--refs-to`, `--refs-from`, `--meta`, override of `-f json`, and interaction with `--limit` (total is reported, not the limit).
